name: Laaj
overview: When love is rejected, it does not always fade away quietly. Sometimes it transforms into revenge—shaped by the lover’s strength, capacity, and the very nature of their character. A wounded heart can become dangerous, especially when pride, obsession, and humiliation begin to mix with emotion. In such moments, love loses its purity and turns into something darker. The desire to be loved is replaced by the urge to punish. And when the lover carries a criminal or destructive mindset, that revenge can be directed at anyone—often even those who were never truly responsible for the rejection.
